meta.note: Events, deadlines and sign-ups for families. `date` and `end` are calendar days (YYYY-MM-DD); `end` is the last day of a run of days or a sign-up window. `kind` is event, deadline or signup. Past entries stay in the file and fold away at the bottom of the Events tab. Every entry carries `src`, and `rid` links the matching row in resources.json where there is one.

events.what: Thanksgiving week: schools, libraries, county offices and buses closed
events.detail: Schools (Buncombe County and Asheville City) are out Nov 25-27, so school meals pause. Libraries and county offices close Thu Nov 26 and Fri Nov 27 (county holiday calendar). ART buses and Mountain Mobility do not run on Thanksgiving Day; ART runs a regular weekday schedule on Friday, per the winter guide. Still open: BeLoved's 24/7 street pantries, free fridges, library parking-lot Wi-Fi (password readmore), and Code Purple on called nights (828-398-6011).
events.note: ART did not run on Thanksgiving or Christmas Day in 2025 and stopped after 6:30pm on Christmas Eve, per city notices; check ridetheart.com/holidays or 828-253-5691 for 2026.
events.where: Buncombe County
events.src: county holiday calendar 2023-2026 and third-party BCS and ACS calendars via web search, 17 Nov 2026; Buncombe County Winter 2026-2027 Holiday Stabilization and Resource Guide, shared by Skylar Belt 17 Nov 2026

events.what: School winter break (BCS Dec 21 to Jan 4; ACS Dec 21 to Jan 1)
events.detail: Buncombe County Schools: no school Dec 21 (teacher workday) through Jan 4 (teacher workday); students back Tue Jan 5. Asheville City Schools: early release Fri Dec 18, out Dec 21 to Jan 1, back Mon Jan 4. School meals pause; plan food, childcare and camps now.
events.note: Dates from third-party copies of the district calendars, which disagree slightly on whether BCS break ends Dec 31 or Jan 1; confirm on buncombeschools.org/calendar and the ACS calendar.
events.where: Buncombe County and Asheville City Schools
events.src: third-party BCS and ACS 2026-27 calendars via web search, 17 Nov 2026; Buncombe County Winter 2026-2027 Holiday Stabilization and Resource Guide, shared by Skylar Belt 17 Nov 2026

events.what: Christmas closures: libraries, county offices, buses and Eblen
events.detail: Libraries and county offices close Thu Dec 24, Fri Dec 25 and Mon Dec 28 (county holiday calendar); the winter guide says branches open Sat Dec 26, 9am-5pm. ART stops early on Christmas Eve and does not run on Christmas Day; Mountain Mobility is also closed Christmas Day. Eblen Charities is closed Dec 23-25, per the winter guide.
events.note: ART did not run on Thanksgiving or Christmas Day in 2025 and stopped after 6:30pm on Christmas Eve, per city notices; check ridetheart.com/holidays or 828-253-5691 for 2026.
events.where: Buncombe County
events.src: county holiday calendar 2023-2026 and city transit notices via web search, 17 Nov 2026; Buncombe County Winter 2026-2027 Holiday Stabilization and Resource Guide, shared by Skylar Belt 17 Nov 2026

events.what: New Year's Day: libraries and county offices closed, buses on Sunday hours
events.detail: Libraries and county offices are closed. ART runs a reduced Sunday-hours schedule (8am-6pm), and Mountain Mobility runs only city paratransit, per the winter guide. Eblen Charities is closed Dec 30 to Jan 1.
events.note: ART ran a reduced holiday schedule on Jan 1 last season, per city notices; check ridetheart.com/holidays.
events.where: Buncombe County
events.src: city transit notices via web search, 17 Nov 2026; Buncombe County Winter 2026-2027 Holiday Stabilization and Resource Guide, shared by Skylar Belt 17 Nov 2026

events.what: MLK Day: schools, libraries and county offices closed
events.detail: No school on Mon Jan 18, and Buncombe County Schools also has a teacher workday Tue Jan 19. Libraries and county offices are closed Jan 18, and ART runs Sunday hours (8am-6pm). Later BCS dates: 2-hour early dismissals Jan 15 and Feb 12, and a teacher workday Feb 15.
events.note: From the winter guide; confirm on the district calendars.
events.where: Buncombe County
events.src: Buncombe County Winter 2026-2027 Holiday Stabilization and Resource Guide, shared by Skylar Belt 17 Nov 2026

events.what: LIHEAP heating help: December window for households with someone 60+ or disabled
events.detail: Households with someone 60 or older, or with a disability and receiving Division of Aging and Adult Services help, can apply in December. Apply at epass.nc.gov, call 828-250-6330, or go to 40 Coxe Ave. Approval also opens Crisis Intervention funds and Duke Energy's monthly bill credit.
events.note: Dates from benefit guides; NCDHHS publishes the official chart each season.
events.src: NC LIHEAP state plan and benefit guides via web search, 17 Nov 2026; Buncombe County Winter 2026-2027 Holiday Stabilization and Resource Guide, shared by Skylar Belt 17 Nov 2026

events.what: LIHEAP heating help opens to all eligible households
events.detail: Households at or below about 130% of the poverty level can apply until March 31 or until funds run out. Apply at epass.nc.gov, 828-250-6330, or 40 Coxe Ave. Renters whose heat is in the rent usually do not qualify.
events.note: Benefit guides give Mon Jan 4 because Jan 1 is a holiday; the winter guide says Sat Jan 2.
events.src: NC LIHEAP state plan and benefit guides via web search, 17 Nov 2026; Buncombe County Winter 2026-2027 Holiday Stabilization and Resource Guide, shared by Skylar Belt 17 Nov 2026

events.what: Black Mountain Holly Jolly, Christmas parade and Circle of Lights
events.detail: Free downtown holiday celebration with carolers and luminaries, the Christmas parade, and the Circle of Lights luminary walk at Lake Tomahawk. The winter guide gives Holly Jolly Fri Dec 4, 5-8pm and the parade Sat Dec 5 at 4pm.
events.where: Downtown Black Mountain and Lake Tomahawk
events.note: Explore Asheville lists both Dec 4 and Dec 5-6, 2026, and a travel site says Helene damaged the Lake Tomahawk trail. Check with the Black Mountain chamber before going.
events.src: Explore Asheville listings via web search, 17 Nov 2026; Buncombe County Winter 2026-2027 Holiday Stabilization and Resource Guide, shared by Skylar Belt 17 Nov 2026

events.what: Lake Julian Festival of Lights (drive-through, paid per car)
events.detail: Buncombe County's drive-through light display, nightly 6-9pm. Tickets are per car, and part of the proceeds goes to Special Olympics Buncombe County.
events.where: Lake Julian Park, 37 Lake Julian Rd, Arden
events.note: One events site gives Dec 2-23, 2026 (the 2025 run was Dec 2-23); the winter guide says Dec 4-23 at $10-20 a car. Not free.
events.src: lake.com listing and past Buncombe County releases via web search, 17 Nov 2026; Buncombe County Winter 2026-2027 Holiday Stabilization and Resource Guide, shared by Skylar Belt 17 Nov 2026

events.what: The Big Crafty holiday craft fair (free on Sunday)
events.detail: Independent artists, toy makers and potters at Harrah's Cherokee Center, noon-6pm both days. Saturday is $10; Sunday Dec 6 is free.
events.where: Harrah's Cherokee Center, 87 Haywood St, Asheville
events.src: Explore Asheville and another event listing via web search, 17 Nov 2026; Buncombe County Winter 2026-2027 Holiday Stabilization and Resource Guide, shared by Skylar Belt 17 Nov 2026

events.what: Weaverville Candlelight Stroll
events.detail: Free evening on Main Street, 6-9pm, with a Winter Wonderland on Florida Avenue. The winter guide adds hot cider, cookies, ornament tables and Santa.
events.where: Downtown Weaverville
events.src: Explore Asheville listing (21st annual) via web search, 17 Nov 2026; Buncombe County Winter 2026-2027 Holiday Stabilization and Resource Guide, shared by Skylar Belt 17 Nov 2026

events.what: National Gingerbread House Competition display (Omni Grove Park Inn)
events.detail: Hundreds of gingerbread houses on display. Viewing is free for non-guests on select evenings and weekdays, but parking costs money and peak weekends may need a reservation. Hotline 800-413-5778.
events.where: Omni Grove Park Inn, 290 Macon Ave, Asheville
events.note: The winter guide says half the parking proceeds go to MANNA and Eblen; not confirmed.
events.src: Omni and Explore Asheville listings via web search, 17 Nov 2026; Buncombe County Winter 2026-2027 Holiday Stabilization and Resource Guide, shared by Skylar Belt 17 Nov 2026

events.what: Kwanzaa at the YMI Cultural Center
events.detail: The YMI hosts Asheville's yearly Kwanzaa celebration with candle-lighting, drumming and storytelling.
events.where: YMI Cultural Center, 39 S Market St, Asheville
events.note: The 2026 schedule was not published when checked. Past years ran a free nightly celebration Dec 26 to Jan 1 at 6pm; the winter guide says Dec 26-27, 12-5pm. Call the YMI.
events.src: past YMI Kwanzaa announcements via web search, 17 Nov 2026; Buncombe County Winter 2026-2027 Holiday Stabilization and Resource Guide, shared by Skylar Belt 17 Nov 2026

events.what: MLK weekend: prayer breakfast and Peace March and Rally
events.detail: The Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. Association's yearly events: a prayer breakfast on the Saturday and a free Peace March from St. James A.M.E. Church to a rally in Pack Square Park on MLK Day, Mon Jan 18. The winter guide adds youth storytelling at the YMI and a family day of service.
events.where: Downtown Asheville
events.note: 2027 times were not published when checked; check mlkasheville.org.
events.src: past MLK Association schedules via web search, 17 Nov 2026; Buncombe County Winter 2026-2027 Holiday Stabilization and Resource Guide, shared by Skylar Belt 17 Nov 2026

events.what: Sign up: winter break day camps (Asheville Parks & Rec, Museum of Science)
events.detail: Full-day camps cover working hours while schools are out. SOAR scholarships cover Parks & Rec camp fees for families with free or reduced lunch, SNAP, Medicaid, Section 8 or SSI, but take up to three weeks, so apply now. The Museum of Science's STEAM Winter Break Camp is on the Events calendar.
events.note: Parks & Rec's 2026 camp dates were not published when checked. In 2025 its Holiday Camp ran Dec 22-23, Dec 29-31 and Jan 2, 8:30am-6pm ($40 first child, $30 each additional), and registration opened Nov 1. The winter guide says Dec 21-23 and 28-31, 8am-5pm, with registration from Nov 21.
events.src: 2025 Parks & Rec holiday roundup via web search, 17 Nov 2026; Buncombe County Winter 2026-2027 Holiday Stabilization and Resource Guide, shared by Skylar Belt 17 Nov 2026

events.what: Nationwide emergency alert test on TV and radio, 2:20pm (only a test)
events.detail: FEMA and the FCC test the Emergency Alert System at 2:20pm Eastern on radio, TV, cable and satellite, in English and Spanish. The message says: "This is a nationwide test of the Emergency Alert System, issued by the Federal Emergency Management Agency, covering the United States from 2:20 to 2:50 hours ET. This is only a test. No action is required by the public." If it has to be moved, it will run on December 3, 2026.
events.note: A heads-up can help families for whom a sudden alarm brings back Helene or another emergency.
events.where: Nationwide (radio, TV, cable and satellite)
events.src: FCC Public Notice DA 26-989, released 16 Sep 2026 (page 1), shared by Skylar Belt 17 Nov 2026

events.detail: Free toys so struggling families have something for their children to open at Christmas, plus a free chuckwagon lunch and pictures with Santa.
